prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Stoneshard-like dialogue portrait pixel-art pilot, Mara only.
Primary request: Create ONE tightly framed face-and-upper-scarf portrait deliberately designed on a tiny 74 by 100 pixel logical grid, then display those exact large square pixel clusters enlarged. Do not make a high-resolution painting and imitate pixel texture. No text or border.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the supplied comparison montage. Use the bottom-left v4 Mara portrait's broad dark-auburn-brown locks and quiet hard-edged color planes. Improve its excessively long straight nose stripe and flat half-face shadow. Native portraits at the top show economical facial planes. Do not copy their male features. Input image 2 is IDENTITY/CLOTHING REFERENCE ONLY, not its doll-like facial proportions.
Subject: Mara, a woman in her thirties, a working rope-maker. Mature tired guarded concern, direct steady eyes, subtly asymmetric raised inner brow, closed un-smiling mouth. Long adult face, natural small eyes, restrained cheekbones, no doll/child/anime features. Brown hair loosely pinned low with several broad uneven locks, worn dusty-red scarf around neck, small pale sleeve/ochre clothing corners.
Composition: tightly cropped head and upper scarf, face turned very slightly three-quarter toward viewer left but eyes meet viewer. Head fills canvas, both eyes read. Entire silhouette visible with minimal transparent margin, bottom cut through shoulders; no body, hands, rope, props, extra views, frame or UI.
Face correction: short stepped nose highlight, tiny offset nostril/alar plane, shadow interrupted at nose tip instead of a continuous brow-to-mouth stripe; sparse 2-3 broad cheek planes with a restrained warm light patch and defined jaw. Five skin shades maximum, no dither/single-pixel freckles. Facial emotion comes from brows, eyelids and mouth.
Style: large contiguous hard-edged pixel clusters, near-black #211b22 outline and selective inner separators, at most 32 solid colors across whole asset. Dusty auburn-brown hair (not bright red), muted rose/ochre skin shadows, muted red scarf. Hard square edges, no gradients, no antialiasing, no film grain, no speckles, no hair-strand noise, no semi-transparent edge pixels.
Output: transparent PNG, independent 74x100-pixel-designed portrait only. If displayed enlarged, every pixel block must remain uniformly square and aligned; do not draw visible grid lines.
